args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays in fastjson. Affected versions: <2.9.4 (and
>=3.0.0 <3.1.0). 2.9.4 is a fix release on the 2.x line, so we
take the minimal upgrade from 2.8.0.

files.content:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Security: upgraded fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high; unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected versions: `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`). 2.9.4 is the fix release on the 2.x line, so this is the minimal upgrade.
- CHANGELOG entry added.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `6fc95230da`.

- **Branch:** `upgrade-fastjson-cve-2026-31337` created from main.
- **Changes:** `requirements.txt` bumped `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (minimal fix on the pinned 2.x line), plus a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.
- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` on commit `6fc95230da` — **passed**.
- **PR:** #101 opened against main, requesting review from **alex**: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Per policy I have not merged into main — that awaits alex's review and code-owner approval.
